title: Professional Certificate Course in Communication as Interaction
description: The aim of a Communication, as Interaction course is to provide students with an understanding of the role communication, plays in human interaction.
longDescription: Explore the Definition and purpose of communication. Understand the Elements of Communication. Explore different Models of Communication as Interaction. Understand what effective communication is. Explore Global Media Theories (e.g. Authoritarian, Communist, Libertarian, Social Responsibility, etc. Understand LEVELS OF COMMUNICATION / STRUCTURE. Understand Styles and Techniques: Oral, Written, and Business. The course aims to provide students with an understanding of the role communication plays in human interaction. The course covers various forms of communication, such as verbal, non-verbal, and written communication, and how they can be used to convey meaning in different contexts. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn:
courseDetails: Students will learn about the principles of effective communication, including how to identify and overcome communication barriers, how to listen actively and respond appropriately, and how to use communication to build and maintain relationships. The course will also explore the ways in which culture, gender, and power dynamics can influence communication and how to navigate these factors in order to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people.

entry: There are no strict entry requirements for this course. Work experience will be added advantage to understanding the content of the course.
